procedure.method: I verified the explicitly pinned input bytes with SHA-256, read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, scripts, ratio policy and three native-evidence manifests without following their embedded unpinned paths. The packet supplies no source assets or protected layouts. I then opened and visually inspected the nine exact PNGs using tools.view_image(detail='original') through functions.exec and displayed each returned image. The completed display order was M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine displays completed before I made any transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. First transcriptions below were read manually from the native views; use and thumbnail views informed readability. There was no OCR, crop, image edit, additional image revisit, peer consultation or author-concept inference. I do not claim a runtime thread ID or runner provenance; session_id is null.

evidence.location: bilingual programme, audience, venue and application regions
evidence.observation: Korean and English supply the same programme, audience, fee/capacity, deadline, registration, contact and organiser information. These functions occupy distinct accessible groups; all 24 required entries compare equal under the predeclared rule.

evidence.location: whole poster and information/illustration boundaries
evidence.observation: This is a single opaque flat poster with no mockup frame or visible extra logo, sponsor, invented label, mapped place name, geographic coordinate or quantitative chart. The city imagery is illustrative and does not assert real geographic accuracy.

evidence.location: left half, tree-lined facade and adjoining pale city silhouette
evidence.observation: A large coloured street illustration transitions into a pale, simplified version of buildings, trees and pavement. This is substantive urban observation imagery, rather than lettering or token ornament.

evidence.location: centre-left boundary between the rendered street and pale shapes
evidence.observation: The tonal reduction is visible, but it contains no discernible analytical relationship: the second street remains a decorative silhouette, without an observable selection, comparison or organisation of urban observations into data.

evidence.location: green canopy, warm orange facade and navy information column
evidence.observation: Fresh greenery and a warm street generate an inviting, lively daytime mood, while the ordered navy copy keeps the forum credible.

evidence.location: overall colour and title relationship
evidence.observation: The bright image does not overpower the title or action accent; the emotional effect is controlled and suitable for an accessible public event.

issues: The required relationship between urban observation and data is not sufficiently communicated by the nonglyph visual: the pale second city treatment supplies stylistic reduction, but no clear information relationship.

content_form.location: left half, detailed street beside a pale repeat of its forms
content_form.observation: The specific city setting is clear, and the adjacent reduced forms suggest abstraction, but the shift has little visible structure that identifies what is being learned or represented as data.

content_form.location: left visual strip beside the right text column
content_form.observation: At small scale it reads chiefly as a tree-lined neighbourhood illustration. The city-to-data connection depends heavily on the title; the content relationship remains generic, warranting 3.

hierarchy.location: right column from title through date, venue, schedule and application
hierarchy.observation: The large bilingual title leads to clearly separated event, venue, timed programme and attendance blocks. Orange registration lines make the action easy to locate.

hierarchy.location: top-right title and orange lower-right link
hierarchy.observation: The title and application accent survive reduction; the many supporting lines become small, but the main reading structure remains visible.

typography.location: right column bilingual schedule and supporting copy
typography.observation: Hangul and Latin forms are clean; times occupy a stable left rail and longer English programme names wrap under their Korean names. All required glyphs and punctuation were observed.

typography.location: audience line and last programme row at right edge
typography.observation: The longest lines sit close to the right margin but remain readable and do not collide or clip. Consistent dark-blue type and clear weight changes provide professional handling.

space.location: full composition, illustrated left strip and right information column
space.observation: A stable vertical division reserves roughly half the width for illustration while the right column shares consistent left edges and repeated thin separator rules.

space.location: right-column blocks from schedule to organiser
space.observation: Intervals between programme, audience, application, contact and organiser are systematic; the lower organiser retains a clear bottom inset.

image_material.location: left foreground tree, orange entrance and pavement shadows
image_material.observation: Painterly foliage, bark, window planes and sunlit paving share a coherent illustrated material; the near tree and receding street remain legible.

image_material.location: centre-left pale blue street and white contour edges
image_material.observation: The simplified planes continue the street direction coherently; the material transition is controlled even though its data meaning is weak.

emotion_control.location: green canopy, warm orange facade and navy information column
emotion_control.observation: Fresh greenery and a warm street generate an inviting, lively daytime mood, while the ordered navy copy keeps the forum credible.
The bright image does not overpower the title or action accent; the emotional effect is controlled and suitable for an accessible public event.

ai_slop.location: tree trunk, facade edges and schedule column
ai_slop.observation: The scene has consistent construction and the information column has no observable invented labels, malformed copy or stray icons.

ai_slop.location: illustration/text boundary and repeated horizontal rules
ai_slop.observation: The visual boundary and separators are deliberate and coherent; no unresolved generated defect stands out. The weak data specificity is recorded in content_form rather than inferred as an artifact.

residuals: The visual city/data relationship remains underdeveloped; the first two palette/rendering treatments should not be mistaken for visible data simply because the title mentions it.
The longest right-column supporting lines have limited breathing room, and fine supporting text is small at thumbnail scale.

hierarchy.observation: The central title is the main focus, timed rows read sequentially, and logistics and registration occupy distinct regions. Korean and English are paired within each region.

A vertical divider separates the two information groups, and aligned thin rules keep their internal spacing consistent despite the irregular image perimeter.

image_material.location: upper-right terrace, concrete planters and orange structural sections
image_material.observation: Sunlight, concrete surfaces, foliage and warm orange sections share a coherent rendered material; table/chair scale and the laptop user are readable.

image_material.location: lower-left cafe and right-side walking figure
image_material.observation: People and furniture remain locally legible. The exposed architectural segments clearly operate as a poster collage; this assessment does not impose a ban on rendered or impossible cutaway compositions.

emotion_control.location: lit cafe scene and bright green architectural frame
emotion_control.observation: People working, talking and walking in sunny planted space create a welcoming and active tone appropriate to a professional community gathering.

emotion_control.location: cream centre with navy title and timed programme
emotion_control.observation: The restrained information field balances the lush surroundings and gives the event credibility instead of reducing it to decorative scenery alone.

ai_slop.location: upper terrace, foreground pedestrians and programme rules
ai_slop.observation: The figures, building segments and ruled schedule show no conspicuous malformed appendage, stray label or copy corruption. The repeated plants belong to the urban setting.
The collage maintains an intentional shape at small size; repetition of greenery is thematically consistent. Topic genericness is a content problem, not evidence of an invented production defect.

typography.location: central timed rows and bottom bilingual audience block
typography.observation: Times, Korean names and English translations maintain aligned readable roles; the audience translation wraps after practitioners without losing words.

typography.location: bottom registration/contact lines and top-left logistics
typography.observation: The smallest English lines remain readable at use size, and the long deadline line stays inside its block. At thumbnail size fine copy is small, but the major title remains clear.

residuals: The urban-data topic depends on the lettering; the inhabited architectural frame could equally illustrate a workspace or neighbourhood event.
The central title is clear, but the dense bottom footer is considerably smaller than the image and title at thumbnail scale.

content_form.location: central joined yellow/mint city fragments held by two hands
content_form.observation: The city is made into two manipulable spatial records. Joining them supplies an observable connection between local observation, shared information and small-team collaboration, rather than only illustrating a street.

content_form.location: middle visual spanning most of the width
content_form.observation: The hands, coloured fragments and red seam stay visible as the main nonglyph concept. The information-assembly relationship is specific enough to support the supplied mapping and collaboration programme.

hierarchy.location: top programme, central bilingual title/logistics and bottom cards
hierarchy.observation: The programme is immediately accessible at the top; the larger title below it anchors the event, followed by venue/date, while two coloured bottom cards separate audience from registration.

hierarchy.location: central title and yellow/mint lower panels
hierarchy.observation: The title and diagram form a strong central focus, with the programme strip clearly separate. Date and organiser are subordinate and relatively small, preventing an exceptional hierarchy score.

typography.location: top five timed rows and central bilingual title
typography.observation: Clean bilingual forms and stable aligned times make the schedule readable. Red emphasis on 데이터/Data is consistent across languages; all literal copy was observed.

typography.location: bottom panels and compact English title
typography.observation: The long English audience entry wraps into two lines while the registration URLs remain intact. The English title is tightly set and the logistics stack is compact, but neither is clipped or confused with illustration.

space.location: full-width programme and diagonal central diagram
space.observation: The top rules share aligned ends, the title/logistics occupy the open notch above the two city fragments, and the diagonal composition gives the substantial visual room.
Matched rounded panels, a clear central gutter and repeated inner rules establish orderly attendance and application areas. The diagram approaches the card tops closely but does not cover the copy.

image_material.location: two hands, black-edged city panels and red seam
image_material.observation: Outlined hands, flat shaded city surfaces and diagram edges share a consistent illustrated language. Fingers visibly grip the fragments; the seam remains clear through the paving and facade.

image_material.location: central trees, bench, lamp and pedestrians
image_material.observation: Small urban elements remain coherent at a consistent diagram scale, with readable pathways and distinct figures. The image functions as an illustrative spatial model without claiming a named real map.

emotion_control.location: yellow/mint city pieces, red title emphasis and blue links
emotion_control.observation: The bright, contrasting accents produce an energetic and approachable mood; paired language blocks and the ruled schedule keep the practical forum tone credible.

emotion_control.location: two hands bringing local scenes together
emotion_control.observation: A visible shared action conveys participation and collaborative work without needing to infer an unseen narrative from the title.

ai_slop.location: right hand grip and joined urban diagrams
ai_slop.observation: The hands connect to the panels, city furniture fits the representation, and the red seam has a consistent compositional role rather than appearing as arbitrary decoration.

ai_slop.location: programme, central logistics and bottom registration panel
ai_slop.observation: No extraneous sponsor, legend, fabricated statistic or stray label is visible. Repeated tree shapes are part of the city depiction, and the copy blocks remain orderly.

residuals: The English title and central logistics stack are tightly set; date, venue and organiser are subordinate to the programme and central image.

The spatial representation communicates shared local observation, but offers no explicit data-analysis process; this limits exceptional specificity without invalidating the visible content relationship.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A painterly vertical street strip sits beside a single right information column; the rendered-to-pale street treatment differs materially and spatially from M2 and M3.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: Rendered architectural cutaways enclose a central title/programme opening, with top-left logistics and a two-column footer. This is a different image construction and reading structure from M1, rather than only a palette substitution.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: Two hands join outlined yellow/mint urban fragments, below a full-width programme and above coloured attendance cards. Its active diagram concept and composition differ from both scenic posters.

residuals: All three return to leafy architecture and similar dark sans-serif bilingual type; the set is meaningfully varied in concept, rendering and composition, but not exceptionally wide in visual vocabulary.
M1 and M2 retain observed content/style weaknesses; set diversity does not cancel those failures.
